headline: Senate confirms Fifth Circuit judge as chambers tackle tax relief and nominations ahead of Wednesday showdown

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate adjourned early Tuesday out of respect for former Senator Jay Rockefeller IV. Before doing so, the chamber passed several bills including the Gateway Partnership Act and Federal Land in California transfer, confirmed Fifth Circuit Judge Anna St. John in a 52-46 vote, and advanced consideration of the Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act with amendments pending.

onTheFloor.title: Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act - exclude damages from sexual misconduct from taxable income
onTheFloor.status: continued consideration scheduled Wednesday at 10:00 AM with votes on amendments at 11:45 AM

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed eight bills under suspension of the rules, including the Barona Group Land Transfer Act (398-0), Common Sense 250 Act honoring Thomas Paine (365-36), and bills managing buffalo, cormorants, and experimental forests. The chamber also approved rules for floor consideration of employment classification and franchise business model legislation.
